prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: fx_escudo_quebra, production candidate standalone compositable VFX. Input image 1 is the mandatory gameplay STYLE reference only; do not reproduce the scene or HUD. 8-frame VFX flipbook of cyan shield bubble breaking apart, transparent empty interior. Frames: intact tense rim, hairline fractures, bright white-blue rupture, separated curved shell shards, shards expanding outward, smaller fading fragments, sparse light motes, almost vanished remnants. Non-looping, centered in each cell, grows and fades smoothly across frames as specified, anime platform-fighter style, bright glossy colors with a white core, transparent background, no text.
Sprite sheet for a 2D side-view fighting game. Strict side view, directional motion facing RIGHT. Grid of 4 columns × 2 rows, 8 equal cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom as frames 1 to 8 of ONE continuous animation. The SAME effect in every cell: consistent design, colors and scale of detail; only the animation state changes, with smooth in-between motion from one frame to the next. Effects centered horizontally in each cell; lowest point for grounded effects on the same baseline at 88% of cell height; floating effects centered vertically; nothing crosses cell borders. Clean cel-shaded anime illustration matching the reference image: thick dark outline (#15101C), two-tone flat shading, crisp rim light in the effect's accent color. Fully transparent background (if transparency is impossible, flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no gradient and no shadow). No grid lines, no frame numbers, no text, no ground, no drop shadow, no characters or scenery. Light from sunset at the left, consistent with reference. Output PNG 1536×768, 384×384 cells. Do not draw a checkerboard.
CRITICAL: Every effect including glow must fit within the central 65% of its cell, with at least 17.5% completely empty transparent padding on all four sides of each cell. No clipping or shared pixels between cells. Transparent empty center for rings and bubbles. No noisy aura filling the sheet. Exact canvas 1536×768.
notes: Gerado pela ferramenta integrada image_gen; model_id real não exposto pelo retorno.
Regras da seção 1 adaptadas a efeitos sem personagem; dimensões solicitadas 1536×768. Saída original preservada sem redimensionamento.
